item: 1 Frame: base on skids and press core
spec: Base: two 60 x 60 x 3 mm tube skids 1.0 m; four 50 x 50 x 3 mm cross tubes; 12 mm base plate 240 x 380 mm; 10 mm lever bracket plates with rest stop bar; two 40 mm x 3 mm tube ties to the base beam. Core: two UPN 80 columns about 0.86 m; base beam of two 20 x 100 mm plates with 20 mm base pin lugs; 16 mm column feet. About 64 kg of mild steel in two bolted pieces (36.6 and 27.7 kg)
notes: Indicative: 64 kg at about $1.30/kg plus about $10 of cutting and drilling; welding labor not included

spec: 12 mm plate walls round a 290 x 140 x 200 mm cavity; 16 x 50 mm stiffening belt round the top; 16 mm side flanges with four M16 holes each; 16 mm push rod guide strap; hinge bracket and latch keeper. About 32 kg
notes: Indicative: 32 kg at about $1.30/kg plus about $15 for cutting and grinding the cavity faces flat and square

item: 3 Lid with ribs, hinge and latch
spec: 20 mm plate 360 x 230 mm with two 20 x 70 mm ribs along the span; 60 mm hinge knuckle on a 30 mm turned pin; hook latch on a 30 mm turned pin; rated for 173 kN block force (EPR-CAL-001). About 26 kg
supplier: Local steel stockist and welder; turned pins from a machine shop
notes: Indicative: 26 kg of steel about $34 plus two turned C45 pins about $6 each

spec: 25 mm plate 288 x 138 mm on a 60 x 60 mm solid bar with a 37 x 200 mm lost-motion slot and a 25 mm foot pin for the eject fork. About 11 kg
notes: Indicative: 11 kg of steel about $15 plus about $8 to drill and grind the slot

spec: Four 28 x 70 mm links, 245 mm between centers; one 24 x 50 mm connecting link, 420 mm between centers; three 35 mm C45 turned pins with retaining clips; ten case-hardened steel bushes 35 mm bore; six grease nipples
supplier: Bearing and power transmission shop; local welder
notes: Indicative: link steel about $20; pins 3 x $10; bushes 10 x $3; grease nipples about $3

spec: 1.7 m of 2 in schedule 40 steel pipe (60.3 x 3.91 mm) with rubber grips and a 0.5 m T-handle for a second operator; 80 mm hub with 107 mm crank plates and a 250 mm socket, on a 40 mm turned shaft in the bracket
supplier: Local steel stockist and welder; turned shaft from a machine shop
notes: Indicative: pipe about $18; hub; crank and socket steel about $12; shaft about $8; grips about $4

item: 7 Eject lever, fork, lever catch and end pawl
spec: Seesaw eject hub on a 30 mm pin between two 10 mm posts on the +X cross tube; two 16 mm fork plates under the push rod foot pin; 250 mm socket for the main lever at 30 degrees; spring-loaded pawl on the lever bracket that holds the lever at the end of the stroke
notes: Indicative: 12.6 kg of steel about $16; pin about $6; pawl spring about $2
